name: SAM
recent: SAM Engineering & Equipment (M) Berhad 近期公告以 EPF 的股东权益变动申报为主，并于 2026 年 8 月 28 日举行第 32 届常年股东大会，所有决议获通过，仅第 10 项普通决议被撤回。公司同时公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度业绩，营收环比增长 21.8%，净利润环比增长 147.7%。
notable: 2026 年 8 月 28 日举行第 32 届常年股东大会，所有决议获股东通过，仅第 10 项普通决议被撤回。
2026 年 8 月 27 日，Datuk Dr. Wong Lai Sum 由独立非执行董事调任为非独立非执行董事。
2026 年 8 月 27 日公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度业绩。
risks: EPF 在 2026 年 8 月至 11 月期间多次申报股东权益变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 424.071 百万，环比增长 21.8%，同比增长 14.7%；净利润为 MYR 13.025 百万，环比增长 147.7%，同比下降 19.6%；净利率为 3.1%，上一季度为 1.5%。

recent_en: SAM Engineering & Equipment (M) Berhad's recent announcements mainly comprise EPF substantial shareholder changes, and its 32nd AGM was held on 28 August 2026 where all resolutions were approved except Ordinary Resolution 10 which was withdrawn. The company also reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 21.8% QoQ and net income up 147.7% QoQ.
notable_en: The 32nd AGM was held on 28 August 2026; all resolutions were approved by shareholders except Ordinary Resolution 10, which was withdrawn.
On 27 August 2026, Datuk Dr. Wong Lai Sum was redesignated from Independent Non-Executive Director to Non-Independent Non-Executive Director.
Quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 were announced on 27 August 2026.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between August and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 424.071 million, up 21.8% QoQ and 14.7% YoY; net income was MYR 13.025 million, up 147.7% QoQ but down 19.6% YoY; net margin was 3.1% versus 1.5% in the prior quarter.
